scripts.speaker: MasterSmith
scripts.text:
Ah...
The pinnacle
of craftsmanship.
That's the work of
a MasterSmith.

scripts.speaker: MasterSmith
scripts.text:
Once you're the
the best of the best,
you begin forging with
the goal of discovering
new and better ways of
crafting...

scripts.speaker: MasterSmith
scripts.text:
The time has come!
Our world needs brave,
hard-working adventurers
like you...

scripts.speaker: MasterSmith
scripts.text:
Would you like to
become a MasterSmith?

scripts.speaker: MasterSmith
scripts.text:
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!

scripts.speaker: MasterSmith
scripts.text:
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.

scripts.speaker: MasterSmith
scripts.text:
Congratulations!
As a MasterSmith,
I hope you will forge
a path towards a brighter
future for Midgard.

scripts.speaker: MasterSmith
scripts.text:
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.

scripts.speaker: MasterSmith
scripts.text:
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
